test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Most people believe that working out and meeting fat loss needs is challenging, but a ________ basic program can take you a long way.
solution: The correct answer is '**consistent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**consistent**'. • It means 'always having the same opinions, standard, behaviour, etc.; not changing'. (विचार, मापदंड आचरण आदि का सदैव एक सा होना; अपरिवर्तनीय) • *Example: There has been a **consistent** improvement in her attitude.* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **erratic**: (used about a person’s behaviour, or about the quality of something) changing without reason; that you can never be sure of. [(व्‍यक्ति का व्‍यवहार) अनिश्चित, सनकी, मनमौजी, अनियत] • **strange**: unusual or unexpected. (असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित; विचित्र; अजीब) • **impartial**: not supporting one person or group more than another; fair. (जिसमें दो पक्षों में से किसी एक को अधिक प्रमुखता न दी जाए; निष्‍पक्ष) • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Most people believe that working out and meeting fat loss needs is challenging, but a **consistent** basic program can take you a long way.* 3f:T5a6, The correct answer is **'No improvement required'.**
